verdict.rationale: Babylon.js itself ships as official SDK packages: NPM packages for every module, tree-shakable ES6 modules, and TypeScript support with full IntelliSense. A runtime probe confirms @babylonjs/core 9.26.1 is published under Apache-2.0 with about 234k weekly downloads, and community reports say the TypeScript integration works well. Missing for 10: official SDKs for languages beyond JavaScript/TypeScript are not documented in depth (Babylon Native is only a thin mention).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Modular design with tree-shakable ES6 modules
`npm view @babylonjs/core version` → 9.26.1 (Apache-2.0, 234,040 weekly downloads via the public npm API)
